title: Steering Geometry: Validating Human Value Geometry in LLM Steering Space
abstract: arXiv:2609.06289v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in alignment-sensitive contexts, activation steering has emerged as a lightweight, inference-time alternative to fine-tuning methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO) for behavioral control. However, existing work typically validates steering on isolated behaviors, leaving it unclear whether steering vectors encode coherent semantic structure or merely exploit behavior-specific shortcuts. We investigate whether the latent geometry of LLM steering vectors reflects theory-specified structure in human values and morality. Using Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values as our primary fine-grained framework, we introduce a 26K-sample benchmark covering 20 human values and analyze distribution-driven methods (e.g., CAA, SphericalSteer, ODESteer) and behavior-centric approaches (e.g., COLD-Steer, BiPO) across diverse model families and sizes. We find that distribution-driven methods recover human value

translated_title: 转向几何：在大语言模型转向空间中验证人类价值几何结构
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被部署在对齐敏感的场景中，激活转向已成为一种轻量级的推理时行为控制方法，可作为微调方法（如RLHF、DPO）的替代方案。然而，现有工作通常在孤立的行为上验证转向效果，这使得转向向量究竟是编码了连贯的语义结构，还是仅仅利用了特定行为的捷径，仍不清楚。我们研究了LLM转向向量的潜在几何结构是否反映了人类价值与道德领域中被理论所规定的结构。以施瓦茨基本人类价值理论作为我们的主要细粒度框架，我们引入了一个包含26K样本、覆盖20种人类价值的基准，并在多种模型家族和规模上分析了分布驱动方法（如CAA、SphericalSteer、ODESteer）和以行为为中心的方法（如COLD-Steer、BiPO）。我们发现分布驱动方法能够恢复人类价值……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于施瓦茨基本人类价值理论构建了包含26K样本、覆盖20种人类价值的基准，首次系统验证了大语言模型转向向量的潜在几何结构能够反映人类价值的理论规定结构。
en_tdlr: This study introduces a 26K-sample benchmark covering 20 human values based on Schwartz's Theory of Basic Human Values, and for the first time systematically validates that the latent geometry of LLM steering vectors reflects theory-specified structures in human values.
